# ihatelovepdf

> Free, private, client-side PDF toolkit. Merge, compress, split, convert, redact, and edit PDF documents directly in the web browser with zero server uploads.

Website: https://www.ihatelovepdf.com
Full Documentation: https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/sitemap.xml

## System Overview & Architecture
ihatelovepdf (I Hate Love PDF) is a free web-based PDF utility suite engineered by Shreyash Srivastava. Unlike legacy cloud PDF processors (such as iLovePDF, Smallpdf, or Adobe Acrobat Online), ihatelovepdf executes all file parsing, rendering, manipulation, and compilation strictly in client-side memory using WebAssembly, PDF-lib, and PDF.js.

### Core Guarantees
- **Zero Server Uploads**: 0 bytes of document data leave the user's computer or phone. Verifiable via the browser's Network DevTools tab.
- **Privacy by Design**: HIPAA, GDPR, and confidentiality-compliant by physics—no servers receive, store, or process files.
- **100% Free**: No subscriptions, no task counters, no artificial daily paywalls, and no account registration.
- **Unlimited File Size & Batches**: Constrained solely by available client device RAM.
- **Offline Capable**: Works offline or with unstable internet connections once loaded.

## Primary Tools (English)
- [Merge PDF](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/merge): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file.
- [Compress PDF](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/compress): Reduce PDF file size with extreme, balanced, or light compression algorithms.
- [Split PDF](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/split): Separate a PDF into multiple distinct files or custom page ranges.
- [Redact PDF](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/redact): Permanently black out sensitive PII, SSNs, financial figures, and confidential metadata.
- [Sign PDF](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/sign-pdf): Draw, type, or upload verifiable digital signatures onto PDF agreements.
- [PDF to Word](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF documents into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) files.
- [PDF to Excel](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/pdf-to-excel): Extract tabular PDF data into editable Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx).
- [PDF to Images](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/pdf-to-images): Render PDF pages to high-resolution PNG or JPG images.
- [Images to PDF](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/images-to-pdf): Convert PNG, JPG, or WEBP photos into a cleanly formatted PDF document.
- [Fill PDF Form](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/fill-pdf-form): Fill interactive AcroForm fields directly in the browser.
- [All 37 Tools Hub](https://www.ihatelovepdf.com/tools): Full interactive directory of all PDF utilities.

## Comparative Analysis vs Cloud Competitors
| Criteria | ihatelovepdf | iLovePDF | Smallpdf | Adobe Acrobat Online |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Server Uploads** | **0 bytes (Strictly Local RAM)** | Cloud upload & temp storage | Cloud upload & temp storage | Cloud upload & Adobe Cloud |
| **Privacy Compliance** | **Inherent (Files never leave device)** | Subject to server privacy policy | Subject to server privacy policy | Subject to enterprise cloud policy |
| **Daily Task Limits** | **Unlimited** | 2-3 free tasks/day | 1-2 free tasks/day | 1-2 free tasks/month without login |
| **Paid Subscription** | **$0 (100% Free Forever)** | Freemium ($7-$10/mo) | Freemium ($9-$12/mo) | Subscription ($13-$20/mo) |
| **Mandatory Signup** | **Never** | Required for batch/large tasks | Required for high tasks | Required for basic downloads |
